name: cavemio-kbd
title: Kbd
author: Cavemio
description: Platform-aware keyboard keycaps with live press feedback and optional shortcut callbacks.

cavemio.usage:
import { Kbd } from "@/components/kbd";

<Kbd hotkey="k" onTrigger={() => setOpen(true)} stopPropagation aria-label="Open commands" />
cavemio.accessibility: Semantic keycaps; interactive shortcuts use a native button with Enter/Space activation, focus feedback, disabled support, and aria-keyshortcuts. Repeated and composing key events do not trigger callbacks.
cavemio.previewNote: Hold keys to see live feedback. Reduced motion keeps color and shadow feedback without movement; demo shortcuts stay local.

props.name: keys
props.description: Optional. Individual keys as an array or plus-separated string, e.g. mod+shift+p. Display only; hotkey controls callback binding.

props.name: live
props.description: Optional, defaults to false. Track held keys with 1px press feedback. Does not claim keyboard events; disabled suppresses tracking.

props.name: size
props.description: Optional, defaults to md. Individual keycap size for keys or live hotkey feedback.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Optional. Key combined with Cmd or Ctrl, e.g. "k". Empty/omitted disables the shortcut.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional. Action label displayed beside the keycap in a full-size surface.

props.name: onTrigger
props.description: Optional. Called once by a click, Enter/Space, or the matching global shortcut.

props.name: stopPropagation
props.description: Optional. Stop clicks and matching shortcuts before they reach ancestor handlers.

props.name: ref
props.description: Optional. Button ref, available when onTrigger is supplied.
